$comment: 출처와 Evidence Span 시드. 인용문(quote)은 원문 그대로이며, PDF 텍스트 추출 과정에서 생긴 줄바꿈과 낱말 중간 공백만 정규화했습니다(quote_normalization 참조). 단어를 바꾸거나 요약하지 않았습니다.
quote_normalization: 인용문 대조 시 양쪽 모두에 적용하는 정규화: (1) 모든 공백 문자 제거, (2) 둥근따옴표·아포스트로피를 곧은 문자로 변환, (3) 대시(–, —)를 하이픈으로 변환, (4) 글머리표(•, ●, ▪) 제거. 단어·어순·숫자는 원문과 동일하며 요약이나 바꿔쓰기를 하지 않았습니다. 이 정규화는 tests/seed-integrity.test.ts가 강제합니다.

sources.title: Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP)
sources.freshness: 2026-08-05 조회 시점 기준. 웹페이지는 예고 없이 변경됨
sources.notes: 원문 바이트 그대로의 스냅샷이 아니라 변환 텍스트입니다. 따라서 이 출처에는 FACT Claim을 연결하지 않았습니다. 맥락 참고용으로만 등록합니다. 규칙 검증(테스트 T5)이 이 제약을 강제합니다.

evidence_spans.section: 1.1 What is the Billing & Settlement Plan (BSP)?
evidence_spans.quote: The BSP is a system designed to facilitate and simplify the selling, refunding, reporting and remitting procedures of IATA Accredited Agents on behalf of BSP Airlines. Through the BSP, IATA consolidates the amounts owed by each Agent and the amounts due to each Airline, enabling the remittance & settlement of those amounts to be made through a single financial transfer for each participant.
When issuing tickets, amounts owing for "Cash sales" are received by the Agent from the customer and held in trust pending remittance to the BSP.

The net amount owing to the BSP from all "Cash" tickets and refunds, as well as any adjustment transactions billed in a given Billing period, must be remitted to IATA's Clearing Bank and received by the Remittance Date specified for the period in question.

The BSP calendar contains three important timelines: Reporting period: The start and end date for each reporting period for which a BSP Billing is produced. Billing date: The dates when the Agent's Billing Reports for each Reporting period will be available on BSPlink. Remittance date: The date by which All Amounts Owing by the Agent for a Reporting period must be remitted by the Agent to IATA's Clearing Bank.
The frequency of both billings and remittances in a BSP is established by the Passenger Agency Conference per the recommendation of the local APJC.
For any Agent with Cash Facility, IATA will assign a Remittance Holding Capacity – a maximum monetary threshold for all BSP "Cash" amounts, held in trust and pending remittance to the BSP.

evidence_spans.section: 3.13 Financial Security for Standard Agents with Cash Facility/Multi-Country Agents
evidence_spans.quote: Before obtaining IATA Accreditation each Standard Agent with Cash Facility or Multi-Country Agent must provide a Financial Security which must be in place for a minimum of the first two years as an Accredited Agent.

evidence_spans.section: 3.13 Financial Security for Standard Agents with Cash Facility/Multi-Country Agents
evidence_spans.quote: Any Financial Security amount will be calculated per the Local Financial Criteria applicable to that market, or per the Multi Country Financial Criteria.

evidence_spans.section: 3.13 Financial Security for Standard Agents with Cash Facility/Multi-Country Agents
evidence_spans.quote: IATA will continuously monitor the amount of Financial Security provided to ensure that the Financial Security amount provided always meet the calculation in the Local Financial Criteria, and if the Agent has increased their sales it is possible that the Financial Security must be increased, or vice versa if the sales have decreased.

All acceptable Financial Security types are available in Resolution 850p and each Agent has the choice of providing which of those Financial Security types that is seen as most beneficial to them, as long as the Financial Security type is available in the market.

evidence_spans.section: 3.14 Failure to Provide a Financial Security
evidence_spans.quote: In case an Agent has been requested to provide a Financial Security and does not do so by the deadline, the Agent will incur a Risk Event of "Failure to Provide a Financial Security." As an immediate consequence, the Agent's authorisation to use the Cash and Credit Card payment methods will be restricted until IATA receives the requested Financial Security.

evidence_spans.section: 15.4 Financial Security calculation – Standard Agents with no Cash Facility
evidence_spans.quote: For (new) Agents under the Standard Accreditation with no Cash Facility, no minimum Financial Security is. As part of the Risk Management, IATA will monitor ADM levels for Agents under this Accreditation type. If ADMs exceed the threshold defined in Resolution 812, Section 5.10, a Financial Security will be required.
This Billing will contain Agent ticket sales and refunds issued and reported on all forms of payment (Cash, Card and IATA EasyPay) as well as adjustment transactions such as ADMs and ACMs

evidence_spans.section: 15.3 Financial Security calculation – Standard Agents with Cash Facility and Multi-Country Agents
evidence_spans.quote: For (new) Agents Accredited for less than two years (or per the Local Financial Criteria, whichever is the longer) and Agents with Risk Status C the Financial Security amount must equal the Remittance Holding Capacity amount.

The BSP Manual for Agents is part of the Passenger Sales Agency Agreement and contains the basic rules and procedures for participation in a BSP. By virtue of this Agreement, all IATA Accredited Agents are bound to apply such procedures in markets where a BSP is implemented.

evidence_spans.section: 2. 검토 내용과 결정 — IFRS 15의 적용 가능한 요구사항
evidence_spans.quote: 문단 B34~B38에서는 기업이 본인인지 아니면 대리인인지를 판단하는 체계를 제시한다. 고객에게 재화나 용역을 제공하는 데에 다른 당사자가 관여할 때, 기업은 약속의 성격이 정해진 재화나 용역 자체를 제공하는 수행의무인지(기업은 본인) 아니면 다른 당사자가 재화나 용역을 제공하도록 주선하는 수행의무인지(기업은 대리인)를 판단한다.
고객에게 재화나 용역이 이전되기 전에 기업이 그 정해진 재화나 용역을 통제한다면 이 기업은 본인이다(문단 B35).

evidence_spans.section: 2. 검토 내용과 결정 — 문단 B37 지표
evidence_spans.quote: 문단 B37에서는 기업이 본인인지 아니면 대리인인지 판단하는 데 도움이 되는 지표를 제시한다. 이러한 지표에는 다음 사항이 포함되지만 이에 한정되지는 않는다. (a) 정해진 재화나 용역을 제공하기로 하는 약속을 이행할 주된 책임 (b) 정해진 재화나 용역이 고객에게 이전되기 전이나, 고객에게 통제가 이전된 후의 재고위험 (c) 정해진 재화나 용역의 가격을 결정할 재량권.
